comments.author: Chetna Samant
comments.headline: Search & Personalization Product Leader | AI-native Discovery, Search & Recommendations | Ex-Unity, Klarna, Snoonu, Intuit
comments.text:
I did this but with Claude scheduler agent, created a coach-me that served me with top-5 advises for the week, and liked it! 
However, over time, I dialled it back heavily. 

It now serves me with only limited-scope speech patterns that I should avoid - speaking verbose and delaying impact kind of stuff.
The pitfalls of coach-me AI are like the pitfalls of a lot of other AI - they are not “human” - they don’t understand the loaded  human context, motivations, goals- they miss and incorrectly advise sometimes, and that is costly over long term.
